compactRecord.n: Taketomi Island — Ryūkyū Village & Kondoi Beach
compactRecord.rs: The most intact traditional Ryūkyū village anywhere. Rent a bicycle, ride the silent coral lanes between hibiscus walls, then sift handfuls of star-sand on Hoshizuna — a model day in the Yaeyamas.
compactRecord.td: 5.4 km² island 10 min by ferry from Ishigaki, designated Important Preservation District for traditional buildings: every house is single-storey, red-tiled with shisa guardian lions on the roof, and surrounded by coral-block walls. Water-buffalo cart
